title: Name the note search index, not the catalog index, in repair and restore errors about it
outcome: Name the note search index, not the catalog index, in repair and restore errors about it
acceptance: When projection repair finds work_note_fts invalid, its error names work_note_fts rather than work_catalog_fts (src/storage/work/schema.rs repair wrapper)
A graph-snapshot restore collision on work_note_fts names that table rather than the catalog FTS (src/storage/work/graph_snapshot/load.rs)
